# GitHub Copilot instructions for AMUN SIGNAL

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/AMUN_ARCHITECTURE.md` before proposing changes. Preserve upstream compatibility, attribution, and the AGPL-3.0 license. Prefer small typed domain modules with tests over additions to large legacy files. Never represent experimental privacy or AI conclusions as proven facts. The product name is AMUN SIGNAL; do not introduce the name "Horus".
